rationale: The daily structure is bearish — an 11.9% gap-up has been sold all session, with price below VWAP ($41.09) and only 27% up the range — but the immediate tape is bullish, with the last two 1-minute candles showing a volume-backed bounce (21k on the final bar) pushing off the lows. Entering short here means fighting live upward momentum before it has tested VWAP resistance, while entering long chases a ~1% bounce with the day's sellers still in control and only ~1% of upside to VWAP against a sub-1% noise band.
